steps.page: async()=>{const timers=window.__megulitReaderIntervals;if(timers.active||timers.running!==0)throw Error('unbound reader timers');window.__replayEvent({type:'call',method:'settingsResetDone',args:['cpu-smoke']});await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1150));if(document.querySelector('[data-seconds]')?.textContent!=='9')throw Error('unbound undo countdown frozen');window.__tomoyoChinese.settingsResetUndone();window.__replayEvent({bound:true});if(!timers.active||timers.running<5)throw Error('bound polling did not resume');window.__replayEvent({type:'gameClosed'});if(timers.active||timers.running!==0)throw Error('closed reader timers leaked');console.warn('CPU_READER_PASS persistent='+timers.count+' unbound-native='+timers.running);}

async()=>{window.cpuFocus=true;Object.defineProperty(document,'hasFocus',{configurable:true,value:()=>window.cpuFocus});window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'));const {driftMount}=await import('/library-drift.js');const host=document.createElement('div'),plane=document.createElement('div'),grid=document.createElement('div');host.style.cssText='width:800px;height:500px;position:relative';host.append(plane);document.body.append(host);const items=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>{const e=document.createElement('div');e.dataset.memberId=String(i);e.innerHTML='<button data-game="'+i+'">fixture</button>';return e;});const stop=driftMount(host,grid,plane,items,false,null);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));await window.gsap?.ticker;let mutations=0;const watch=new MutationObserver(list=>mutations+=list.length);watch.observe(plane,{subtree:true,attributes:true,attributeFilter:['style']});for(let i=0;i<3;i++){window.cpuFocus=false;window.dispatchEvent(new Event('blur'));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80));mutations=0;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120));if(mutations)throw Error('drift draws while blurred '+mutations);window.cpuFocus=true;window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus'));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80));if(!mutations)throw Error('drift did not resume');}watch.disconnect();stop();host.remove();console.warn('CPU_DRIFT_PASS blur/focus cycles=3');}
